T: Black and white. And red all over.
D: A young fashion designer in 1970s London turns into the infamous Cruella.
P: Serve the snacks when Cruella crashes the Baroness's black and white ball.
S: Blinis with crème fraîche and black roe, white chocolate dipped strawberries
Blinis spread with crème fraîche and topped with black lumpfish roe, beside strawberries half dipped in white chocolate, all on black trays.
Thick twice fried chips shaken with malt vinegar and salt
Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, served in paper with plenty of malt vinegar and salt.
Wink, the little dog who goes everywhere in disguise

Crisp crostini spread with whipped feta and topped with black olive and black sesame spots, finished with chilli honey. Slice a baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with olive oil and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until crisp. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Spread thickly on the crostini. Dot with finely chopped black olives from 60g and a sprinkle of black sesame seeds to make spots. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey warmed with a pinch of chilli flakes.
M: Beef fillet wrapped in mushrooms, prosciutto and pastry

Beef Wellington of fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles and puff pastry, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. Sear a 1kg beef eye fillet all over and brush with Dijon. Cook 400g chopped mushrooms until dry. Lay prosciutto on cling wrap, spread with the mushrooms, roll around the beef and chill. Wrap in puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
Jasper and Horace's full English fry-up
pork sausages, bacon, fried eggs, mushrooms, grilled tomato, beans and toast, for the hideout crew

Thick pork sausages, crisp bacon, fried eggs, mushrooms, grilled tomato and baked beans with buttered toast, a hideout fry-up on one plate. Fry 8 thick pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned. Fry 8 bacon rashers alongside until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes and fry cut side down with 200g sliced mushrooms in butter for 5 minutes. Warm 2 cans baked beans. Fry 4 eggs in the pan fat. Toast and butter 4 thick slices of bread and load everything onto 4 plates with brown sauce.
W: Cocoa sponge layers filled with white chocolate whipped cream
Two chocolate sponges baked at 175C for 30 minutes, split and layered with white chocolate whipped cream, chilled and sliced to show the black and white stripes.
K: Hibiscus tea and raspberry syrup topped with bubbles

Deep red hibiscus and raspberry syrup with lime, topped with sparkling water over ice, as loud as the dress reveal. Steep 2 tbsp dried hibiscus flowers in 300ml boiling water for 10 minutes, then strain. Simmer with 125g raspberries and 80g caster sugar for 5 minutes, mash and strain again, then chill. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 60ml syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each, then top with sparkling water. Garnish with raspberries.

dishes.make_ahead: Dip the strawberries up to 4 hours ahead and keep them chilled; top the blinis with crème fraîche and roe just before serving

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries halfway in the chocolate and set on baking paper.
Leave the chocolate to set.
Top the blinis with crème fraîche and a little black roe.
Lay both out on black trays in strict rows, black and white only.

veg.make_ahead: Lentils up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the lentils until just tender, drain and dress with the soy sauce and oil. Cool.
Melt the white chocolate gently.
Dip the strawberries halfway in the chocolate and set on baking paper.
Leave the chocolate to set.
Top the blinis with crème fraîche and a little spoonful of the black lentils.
Lay both out on black trays in strict rows, black and white only.

dishes.make_ahead: Do the first fry up to 2 hours ahead and rest the chips; fry again at 190C just before serving

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, rinse and dry.
Heat the oil to 140C and fry until soft.
Rest the chips.
Reheat the oil to 190C and fry until crisp.
Tip into paper and shake over plenty of malt vinegar and salt.

dishes.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, brush with egg and bake when needed

steps.text: Sear the beef all over in a hot pan with the oil.
Brush with Dijon and cool.
Chop the mushrooms and cook until completely dry.
Cool the mushrooms.
Lay prosciutto on cling wrap, spread with the mushrooms and roll around the beef.
Chill the roll.
Wrap in puff pastry and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200C.
Rest before slicing.

veg.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, brush with egg and bake when needed

ingredients.item: large butternut pumpkin, neck only, peeled

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin neck lengthways, rub with 1 tbsp of the oil and salt and roast at 200C until just tender. Cool, then brush with the Dijon.
Cook the mushrooms and thyme leaves in the remaining oil until completely dry, stir in the soy and cool.
Wilt the spinach and squeeze dry. Lay it on cling wrap, spread with the mushrooms, sit the pumpkin halves together on top and roll up tightly. Chill the roll.
Wrap in puff pastry and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200C until deep golden.
Rest before slicing.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Bake in 2 tins at 175C.
Cool the cakes completely.
Melt the white chocolate and cool.
Whip the cream with the melted chocolate.
Split each layer and fill with the cream.
Chill, then slice to show the stripes.

dishes.make_ahead: Syrup up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the hibiscus in the boiling water, then strain.
Simmer with half the raspberries and the sugar.
Mash and strain again.
Chill the syrup.
Fill glasses with ice, add syrup and a little lime juice to each.
Top with sparkling water and garnish with raspberries.

w.note: Cocoa sponge layers filled with white chocolate whipped cream
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 40g cocoa. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Split each layer and fill with cream whipped with melted white chocolate. Chill and slice to show the stripes.
